### npm

`Npm` · `src/npm.ts:11`

How a runner installs the packages of a directory: exactly as its lockfile says, in a clean node_modules (the lockfiles of Trame, of its libraries and of the project are the ones the plan names).

Source: npm documentation, CLI commands: npm ci · `https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/commands/npm-ci`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `install` | `npm ci` | Installs what the lockfile says, nothing else, after removing node_modules |
